note: Internal inconsistencies of the comparator reported by an external review, recorded with the evidence state of EACH side. A side is HELD only when its quote is located verbatim in bytes this repository holds; otherwise it is typed REPORTED_NOT_HELD with who reported it and why it is not held. Neither number is imported as truth, and nothing here enters the overlap relation.

sides.quote: Fifteen RCTs (n = 3252 patients) were included in this review.

sides.where: all-cause mortality forest plot, arm totals
sides.reported_by: external review of the corticosteroids-CAP topic (27 Sep 2026)
sides.why_not_held: full text is subscription-only (Europe PMC: 'Subscription required'; no PMC copy) and ScienceDirect answered with a bot-verification page, which was not bypassed

reported_trial_membership.reported_by: external review of the corticosteroids-CAP topic (27 Sep 2026)
reported_trial_membership.claim: both of our pooled trials (CAPE COD; Torres 2015) are rows of the comparator's 14-comparison mortality forest plot: trial level 2 shared, 0 ours only; outcome-level rows differ (e.g. Meduri's 60-day row)
reported_trial_membership.why: the comparator's trial set is not held, so the computed overlap relation stays NOT_ENUMERABLE until the forest plot or included-study table is held
